_comment: Narrator lines for Silas, the Barkeep of Midnight (spec §5). Keyed by phase -> array of variants. {NAME}/{ROLE} are template slots. The server picks a random variant and fills slots before sending NARRATE.

lobby: Step inside. Coats on the rack, secrets in your pocket. We don't start 'til everyone's a stranger.
Welcome to Midnight, friend. Pull up a stool. Trust nobody — not even the bartender.
game_start: Doors are locked. Everyone's here who's gonna be here. Let's see who walks out.
The roster's set. Somewhere in this room, the wrong people are smiling.
night_falls: Midnight bolts its doors. Honest folk, close your eyes and dream. Family, doctor, detective — open your phones. You've got work to do.
Lights low, heads down. If you move in the dark tonight, your phone's waiting. Everyone else, sleep — and hope.
The last lamp gutters out. Those with business tonight, tap it out on your phones. The rest of you, eyes shut.
Curfew, friends. Town, dream of better days. Family — you know which pocket your phone's in.
night_last_call: Clock's running thin, night owls. Make your move before the sun catches you standing over the body.
Tick, tick. Whatever you're doing in the dark, do it now — dawn doesn't wait.
Almost sunup. Anyone still deciding had better decide fast.
mafia_prompt: You know the drill. Choose who doesn't see the sunrise.
detective_prompt: You've got a hunch, counselor. Give me a name and I'll check the ledger.
Whose story doesn't add up? Point me at 'em.
doctor_prompt: Somebody's gonna bleed tonight, doc. Pick who you keep breathing.
Your bag's packed. Choose the one you'll sit up with.
citizen_prompt: You've got no move tonight — make one anyway. Keeps the neighbors guessing.
Pick a name, any name. It means nothing. That's the point.
Eyes shut, finger out. The house enjoys a little theater.
detective_result_clean: I checked the ledger on your hunch. The name comes back… clean.
Ran it down. {NAME}? Their hands are clean. For now.
detective_result_dirty: I checked the ledger on your hunch. The name comes back… dirty.
{NAME} is in it up to the neck. That one's family.
morning_death: Sun's up. And so's the body count. We found {NAME} face-down by the piano. They won't be ordering another.
Morning, friends. One less stool's taken. {NAME} took a dirt nap in the night.
morning_no_death: Funny thing — everybody's still breathing. Somebody upstairs was watching out.
No body this morning. Either the family got cold feet, or somebody played guardian angel.
Dawn, and every glass still has an owner. Whoever was watching last night — the house owes you one.
day_discussion: Sun's up — so talk. Out loud, eyes up. Somebody here is lying. Say your piece, then tap Ready; the vote comes when you're all set.
Floor's open. Argue, accuse, defend. Tap Ready when you're done — or let the clock decide for you.
Daylight, and suddenly everyone's a saint. Hash it out loud. Hit Ready when you've made up your mind.
Another sunrise nobody paid for. Talk fast, trust slow — and tap Ready when your mind's made up.
discussion_last_call: Wind it down, friends — the floor's closing and the ballot box is coming out.
Save your breath for the vote. Time to talk is nearly spent.
Last few words before fingers start pointing. Make 'em count.
all_ready: That's everyone nodding. No sense stalling — phones up, let's vote.
Room's made up its mind early. Straight to the ballot, then.
Everybody ready? Good. Grab your phones — time to point fingers.
vg_didnt_catch: Say that again, friend — I didn't catch it.
Come again? The room's loud tonight.
Didn't quite get that. One more time, slower.
vg_confirm: Hold on — say 'wait' if you want me to stop. Otherwise, here we go.
That's a big move. Speak up now if you want to take it back.
Alright. Last chance to say 'wait' — or I'll set it in motion.
vg_scrapped: Scratch that. The floor's still yours.
vg_roster_intro: Here's who's still on their feet.
The living, such as they are —
vg_not_now: Can't do that just now, friend.
Not the moment for that one.
vg_rules: Simple enough. Every night the family picks someone to disappear. The doctor patches one soul, the detective checks one name. Come morning we count the dead, argue it out, and the room votes someone to the door. Town wins if the family's finished. The family wins when they're the last ones laughing. Trust nobody.
vote_call: Time's up for talk. Phones out — point a finger, or abstain if you've got no spine.
Last call. Grab your phone and cast your vote. Somebody's taking the long walk.
Ballots on your phones now. Choose — and mean it.
The room's gone quiet. Good. Phones up — somebody buys the next round in hell.
vote_last_call: Ballot's closing, friends. Undecided is still a decision — and a dangerous one.
Seconds left on the vote. Point now, or let the room decide without you.
Final grains in the glass. Cast it or lose it.
time_extended: Relax — I'm pouring another round. The clock can wait a spell.
House says you get a little longer. Don't waste it on small talk.
More time on the meter, friends. The night's not done with you yet.
vote_tie: Can't make up your minds? The room splits, nobody swings. Cowards live another round.
Deadlock. Nobody hangs tonight — but the night's coming back.
elimination: {NAME}, the room's decided. The door's that way. …Turns out they were {ROLE}.
Sorry, {NAME}. Majority rules. Pour one out — they were {ROLE} all along.
town_win: Last rat's in the river. Midnight's clean tonight. Drinks on the house.
The family's finished. Town breathes easy. First round's on me.
And that's the last of 'em. Midnight keeps her doors open another day. To the honest — and the lucky.
mafia_win: The family runs this town now. Always did. Goodnight, friends — what's left of you.
Lights out for the good guys. Midnight belongs to the family. It always did.
Take a look around, friends. Every hand at this table wears a ring now. The family thanks you for your patronage.
